MEMORANDUMOFLEASE NAMEANDADDRESSOF LANDLORD: Cornell University 1300York Avenue NewYork,NewYork10021 NAME AND ADDRESS OF TENANT: Sotheby's, Inc. 1334YorkAvenue New York,New York 10021 DATEOFEXECUTIONOF LEASE: October _1,2025 DESCRIPTIONOFPREMISES: The premises consist of (i) from the date of Lease execution (the“Commencement Date") until the date that is six (6) months following the Commencement Date (the "Temporary Space Expiration Date"), a portion of the Ground Floor of the building located at 1334 York Avenue,New York,New York (the“Building"),the entire Second Floor of the Building,the entire Third Floor of the Building and the entire Fourth Floor of the Building and (i) from the Commencement Date until the last day of the calendar month in which the day preceding the tenth (1oth) anniversary of the Commencement Date occurs (the “Expiration Date"), the entire Seventh Floor of the Building (including the 7th Floor Premises (Mezzanine)), the entire Eighth Floor of the Building, the entire Ninth Floor of the Building, and the entire Tenth Floor of the Building. TERM OFLEASE: The term of the Lease is ten (10) years, commencing on the Commencement Date and ending on the Expiration Date.unless sooner terminated pursuant toany of the terms of the Lease or pursuant to law. SIGNAGERIGHTS: The Lease grants certain signage rights to Tenant and contains certain limitations on the granting of signage by Landlord, each as more particularly set forth in the Lease. INITIAL LEASING RESTRICTIONS: The Lease contains certain restrictions regarding the initial leasing of certain space in the Building, as more particularly set forth in the Lease. -2- SMRH 4921-1811-9278 2 72BP-417969

USEANDLEASING RESTRICTIONS: The Lease contains certain restrictions regarding the use and leasing of space in the Building, including but not limited to the use and leasing of space for retail COMPETITORRESTRICTIONS: The Lease contains certain restrictions regarding the leasing of space in the Building to certain competitors of Landlord, as more particularly set forth in the Lease. NAMING RIGHTS: The Lease contains certain restrictions regarding naming the Building after certain SUBORDINATION: The Lease shall be subject and subordinate to future mortgages and ground leases; provided Landlord obtains non-disturbance agreements in compliance with the terms and conditions of the Lease. TERMS OF LEASE GOVERN: The rights, obligations and remedies of Landlord and Tenant, respectively, with reference to each other and the Premises shall be fixed, determined and governed solely by the terms of the Lease,this being a memorandum of leaseexecuted by the parties hereto solely for the purpose of providing an instrument for recording, in lieu of recording the Lease. Thepartiesheretohave executed and delivered thisMemorandum of Leaseforthe purpose of giving notice of the Lease to whomsoever it may concern. For a statement of the rights,privileges and obligations created under and by the Lease and of the options, terms, covenants and conditions contained therein, reference should be made to the Lease. Capitalized terins used but not defined herein shall have the meaning ascribed to such terms in the Lease. This Memorandum of Lease may be executed and acknowledged in any number of counterparts and each shall be deemed to be an original and to constitute part of the same document.
